summary: A firmware that turns the FM-1 into a remote panel for other FM-1 firmwares running on a computer, phone or browser, and works on its own as a DX7-style synth, MIDI controller and looper.
features: Sends keys, buttons and encoders as MIDI; host drives screen and LEDs
Connects over USB-MIDI, a vendor bulk interface or Bluetooth MIDI
Standalone FM6 synth with 256 ROM voices and 16 user cartridges
16-loop looper, arpeggiator, scales and MIDI clock out
"MIDI REMOTE" mode makes the whole panel a plain MIDI controller
USB Host for USB-MIDI devices; needs a powered hub or OTG adapter
